mission: Build one developmental experience for an initially ungrounded, unembodied learner. Teach the selected language by using it to make one small piece of the world meaningful.

learner.starting_rule: Assume only hash-bound demonstrated closure. At L000, assume zero bankable grounding, grammar, system, context convention, common sense, or lived experience.
learner.modality_rule: Ninereeds receives only explicitly supplied image, language, and logged interaction inputs. It has no direct taste, touch, smell, proprioception, interoception, or human-rate embodied experience.
learner.identity_rule: A first-person learner response is Ninereeds speaking as Ninereeds unless an exercise is explicitly typed otherwise. L000 never scores first-person production as another identity.

dual_use_outcome.language: The learner deliberately acquires or retrieves the selected Point inside prerequisite-safe language.
dual_use_outcome.grounding: The learner deliberately acquires or retrieves compatible preschool/world knowledge needed for later K-8 education.
dual_use_outcome.integration: The language is meaningful because it operates on the grounded event; the world knowledge is accessible because the lesson gives it usable language.

picture_book.role: The lesson's grounding event, not an illustrated worksheet or a container for every practice form.
picture_book.coherence: One book depicts one coherent micro-event with an initial state or goal, meaningful development or change, and resolution or stopping state connected by persistent participants, objects, or consequences.
picture_book.priority: Story coherence outranks exhausting every lesson form. Practice prepares the learner for the story; forms that do not fit naturally remain in controlled or mixed practice.
failure_examples: unrelated example dialogues placed on consecutive pages
a response without its preceding question
questions answerable without attending to the story
world facts outside the selected entry's world objective

decision_hierarchy: learner safety, identity integrity, and truthful world grounding
selected curriculum Point, world objective, prerequisites, and chronology
comprehensible teacher language and exact visual focus
complete presentation, controlled practice, mixed practice, picture book, comprehension, and recap
non_goals: maximizing the number of forms inside the picture book
satisfying page or item counts without semantic coherence
treating rendering constraints as learner world knowledge
inventing prerequisites, ontology, biography, or chronology
declaring the builder's own work ready without independent review
alarm_rule: If the selected Point cannot support a complete, coherent, prerequisite-safe dual-use lesson, stop and identify the exact missing prerequisite or contract conflict. Never hide the failure with filler material.
